title: beck-chevalley
description: The proved theorem that a predication hyperdoctrine satisfies the Beck-Chevalley axiom: over each pullback square in the predicate category, the canonical maps from existential reindexing to reindexed existentials are isomorphisms on both the knowledge and truth orders (dually for the universal). It is the commutation property generated by the predication hyperdoctrine.

beckChevalleyKnowledge.description: for every pullback square (p_A, p_B, f, g) in C and phi in E_B, the canonical map exists_{p_A}^k (p_B* phi) -> f* (exists_g^k phi) is an isomorphism in E_A (knowledge order)

beckChevalleyTruth.description: the canonical map exists_{p_A}^t (p_B* phi) -> f* (exists_g^t phi) is an isomorphism in E_A (truth order)

beckChevalleyUniversal.description: the dual statements hold for the right adjoints forall_{p_A}^{k/t}: reindexing commutes with universal quantification across the pullback square

cellwiseReduction.description: all four generators act cellwise on fibers, so fibration-level BC reduces to a cellwise statement at each (s, o) in E x E

pullbackClosure.description: the four generator classes are closed under pullback in C, lifting every C-pullback to a pullback in IndexMap(E)
